scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --env homologacao --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env homologacao
scripts.db:migrate:homologacao: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env homologacao
scripts.deploy:homologacao: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env homologacao
scripts.deploy:producao: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env producao
scripts.preview:homologacao: npm run build && wrangler versions upload --env homologacao
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc package.json index.html
